title: A Compass for the Bridge
author: Sebastian Dravenmoor
blurb: Ines Okonkwo, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
